claim_boundary: This preregistration permits only a zero-field GFN2-xTB MOLDEN permanent-source representation round trip. It supersedes a recorded v1 runner-import preflight failure; the v2 change is confined to importing the frozen source in its package context. It forbids reuse of the rejected xTB response and forbids continuum, solvation, force, runtime, or experimental-accuracy claims.
decision_rule: If every representation gate passes, admit the GFN2 MOLDEN state only as a permanent-reference candidate to a separately preregistered static QM-MEP source test. Do not use xTB field response, interpolate its response, run a PCM calculation, construct a solvation ledger, or report an accuracy value. If any representation gate fails, reject the MOLDEN source rather than changing the shell convention, effective core, cutoff, or tolerance from this result.

V2 changes only the module loader: it imports the named source package from the frozen checkout and verifies that module path. Candidate identity, geometry, xTB runtime, hard constraints, numerical gates, and scientific decision rule are unchanged.
